server.label: Server Config
server.desc: Port, address, and CORS settings for frontend/backend services. Port changes require service restart.

storage.label: Storage Config
storage.desc: Knowledge base file system storage path configuration.

vector.label: Vector Search Config
vector.desc: ChromaDB vector index and retrieval parameters for semantic search.

embedding.label: Embedding Model Config
embedding.desc: Text embedding model parameters affecting vector indexing and search quality.

graph.label: Knowledge Graph Config (Neo4j)
graph.desc: Neo4j graph database connection and knowledge graph build parameters.

search.label: Two-Stage Search Config
search.desc: BM25 + vector two-stage precision search parameter tuning.

mineru.label: MinerU OCR Engine
mineru.desc: PDF/DOCX document OCR parsing engine configuration. Port auto-assigned.

experience_auto.label: Experience Auto-Summary (Meditation)
experience_auto.desc: Periodically auto-extract experience drafts from frequent queries + KB answers.

cors_origins.label: CORS Origins
cors_origins.desc: Cross-origin allowed origins list. ["*"] for all (dev recommended).

host.label: Listen Address
host.desc: Network interface the backend binds to. 0.0.0.0 = all interfaces.

tree_fs_root.label: KB Storage Path
tree_fs_root.desc: Tree file system root directory path.

enabled.label: Enable Vector Search
enabled.desc: Enable ChromaDB semantic search. Disable falls back to BM25 keyword search.

top_k.label: Top K Results
top_k.desc: Number of most similar results from vector search.

score_threshold.label: Doc Score Threshold
score_threshold.desc: Minimum cosine similarity for document vector search. bge-m3: 0.3-0.5.

experience_score_threshold.label: Experience Score Threshold
experience_score_threshold.desc: Minimum similarity for experience retrieval, higher than document threshold.

batch_size.label: Batch Size
batch_size.desc: Document chunks per inference batch. GPU can increase for speed.

normalize.label: Vector Normalization
normalize.desc: L2 normalization makes cosine similarity equal to dot product.

password.label: Password
password.desc: Neo4j password. Env NEO4J_PASSWORD takes priority.

connection_acquisition_timeout.label: Acquisition Timeout (s)
connection_acquisition_timeout.desc: Max wait time to acquire connection from pool.

max_attempts.label: Max Retry Attempts
max_attempts.desc: Max retry attempts after operation failure.

base_delay.label: Base Retry Delay (s)
base_delay.desc: Initial retry wait time, exponential backoff.

two_stage.label: Two-Stage Search
two_stage.desc: Stage 1 BM25 broad recall, Stage 2 vector precision ranking.

stage2_top_k.label: Stage 2 Precision Count
stage2_top_k.desc: Final results after vector precision ranking.

min_candidates.label: Min Candidates
min_candidates.desc: Minimum candidate documents for two-stage search.

startup_timeout.label: Startup Timeout (s)
startup_timeout.desc: Max time to wait for MinerU ready.

interval_hours.label: Run Interval (hours)
interval_hours.desc: Interval between meditation cycles. Hot-applied on next cycle.

lookback_days.label: Lookback Days
lookback_days.desc: Scan Q&A history from last N days as induction source.

min_cluster_count.label: Min Cluster Size
min_cluster_count.desc: Similar questions must appear at least N times before induction.

max_drafts_per_run.label: Max Drafts Per Run
max_drafts_per_run.desc: Maximum experience drafts per meditation run.

dry_run.label: Dry Run Mode
dry_run.desc: Only log induction results, don't create drafts. For parameter tuning.

APP_MODE.label: App Mode
APP_MODE.desc: dev = development (hot-reload); prod = production. Determines which config.yml section to use.

BACKEND_PORT.label: Backend Port Override
BACKEND_PORT.desc: Override config.yml backend port. Leave empty to use config.yml value.

WEB_PORT.label: Frontend Port Override
WEB_PORT.desc: Override config.yml frontend port. Leave empty to use config.yml value.

TREE_STORAGE_PATH.label: Storage Path Override
TREE_STORAGE_PATH.desc: Override config.yml storage.tree_fs_root. Leave empty to use config.yml value.

NEO4J_PASSWORD.label: Neo4j Password
NEO4J_PASSWORD.desc: Neo4j password. Takes priority over config.yml graph.password.

NO_RELOAD.label: Disable Hot Reload
NO_RELOAD.desc: Set to 1 to disable hot-reload even when APP_MODE=dev.

PYTHONUTF8.label: Force UTF-8
PYTHONUTF8.desc: Set to 1 to force Python UTF-8, fixing Windows GBK issues.

envSection.label: Environment Variables (.env)
envSection.desc: Env vars take priority over config.yml. Restart required for full effect.
